chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Umar ibn Yazeed, who said:
I was having dinner with Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) when he recited this Verse:
But! The human being is evidence against himself * Although he puts forth his excuses
O Abu Hafs! What is the human doing if he apologises to the people with against what Allah knows from him.
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) was saying: ‘The one does something secretly, Allah would Clothe it in return – if good, so good, and if evil, so evil’.

key_terms.رِدَاءَهَا: His clothing of it (metaphor for manifestation)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Allah clothing a person with their secret actions?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, the Imam (peace be upon him) elucidates the verse from Surah al-Qiyamah, explaining that human self-witnessing (basirah) renders external excuses futile since Allah knows the inner reality. He connects this to the Prophetic tradition that one's secret intentions are manifested externally as a 'garment' of their true nature, a concept central to Shia teachings on sincerity (ikhlas) and the transition from inner state to outer action.
